title: Grangegorman, Grangegorman Lower, Dublin 7

prs.location: Ideally located beside TU Dublin Grangegorman and approximately 2km from Trinity College, with direct Luas and bus links across Dublin, including routes serving UCD.

description:
Located in the Grangegorman area of Dublin, this modern student residence offers high-quality en-suite rooms within a secure and well-managed development. Situated right beside TU Dublin Grangegorman and approximately 2km from Trinity College, the property is ideally positioned for students seeking city-centre living with excellent connectivity.

The area is well served by the Luas Red Line and multiple bus routes, including direct connections to UCD, making it a popular choice for students commuting across the city. It offers a vibrant atmosphere while remaining convenient for both study and day-to-day living.

A range of en-suite rooms are available for the 2026/27 academic year and full-year bookings, with prices starting from €325 per week, inclusive of bills. Rooms are single-occupancy and typically range from 12m² to 22m², featuring a small double bed, private en-suite bathroom, and fully furnished layout including study space and storage. Apartments are shared with 3–8 other residents and include a fully equipped kitchen and living area.

Summer stays are also available, with short-term bookings offered at €320 per week (all-inclusive).

Please note: Studio apartments are currently fully booked due to strong demand. However, alternative studio options may be available, and enquiries are welcome for those specifically seeking a studio.

Room availability can fluctuate, and options may vary throughout the year.

To enquire or secure a room, please get in touch with StudentHouse.
